title: The Agent in the Middle: How AI-Mediated Access Reshapes Web Vulnerability Exploitation
title_zh: 中间的智能体：AI中介访问如何重塑Web漏洞利用

paragraphs.en: VELA基准研究表明AI智能体中介访问下91%的Web漏洞仍可被利用，接口设计是可利用性的关键。 Web services increasingly expose backend interfaces that let users delegate tasks to AI agents, which invoke service operations directly without navigating websites. This shift changes how existing Web vulnerabilities can be exploited. We investigate these changes through VELA, an executable benchmark covering 44 vulnerabilities across twelve Web application families. The benchmark preserves vulnerable backends and derives agent-facing interfaces from legitimate workflows. We evaluate three commercial agents across multiple interface configurations, using controlled comparisons to separate interface effects from agent behavior and independent oracles to verify attack outcomes. Our results show that the agent realizes every attack that direct interface invocation realizes in the reference configuration, so exploitability is set mainly by the interface: 91% of vulnerabilities remain exploitable under the reference design. Interface restrictions prevent some attacks by removing required operations or limiting input control, while retention remains high across vulnerability classes. No case-level loss in the reference configuration is attributed to agent refusal or input normalization, and in one case the agent completed an attack by supplying calls the attacker omitted. Across the tested configurations, interface design affects exploitability more than agent choice, moving retention from 39% to 95% against at most 4.5 points across agents, but some restrictive interfaces also limit legitimate workflows. Our study provides a systematic empirical account of how agent-mediated access reshapes existing Web vulnerabilities, grounding future Web architecture design in measured security outcomes and trade-offs between reducing attack exposure and preserving legitimate functionality in agent-facing services.
paragraphs.zh: VELA基准研究表明，在AI智能体中介访问下91%的Web漏洞仍可被利用，接口设计是决定可利用性的关键。越来越多的Web服务暴露后端接口，让用户将任务委托给智能体，智能体直接调用服务操作而无需浏览网站。 这一转变改变了现有Web漏洞被利用的方式。 我们通过VELA研究这些变化，VELA是一个可执行的基准，涵盖十二个Web应用家族中的44个漏洞。 该基准保留了存在漏洞的后端，并从合法工作流中推导出面向智能体的接口。 我们在多种接口配置下评估三个商业智能体，使用受控比较将接口效应与智能体行为分离，并使用独立的判定标准验证攻击结果。 我们的结果表明，在参考配置下，智能体能实现直接接口调用所能实现的所有攻击，因此可利用性主要由接口决定：91%的漏洞在参考设计下仍可被利用。 接口限制通过移除所需操作或限制输入控制来阻止部分攻击，但各类漏洞的保留率仍然很高。 在参考配置中，没有任何案例层面的损失归因于智能体拒绝或输入规范化，其中一个案例中智能体通过补充攻击者遗漏的调用完成了攻击。 在所测试的配置中，接口设计对可利用性的影响大于智能体选择，使保留率在39%到95%之间变化，而不同智能体之间的差异最多为4.5个百分点，但一些限制性接口也会妨碍合法工作流。 我们的研究为智能体中介访问如何重塑现有Web漏洞提供了系统的实证分析，以度量的安全结果以及减少攻击暴露与保留合法功能之间的权衡为基础，为未来的Web架构设计提供依据。
